## Outcome

My first version of multiline facet labels created separate SVG lines, but the extra line could still overlap the data panel. I added a browser-geometry test that exposed the problem and then fixed the strip placement.

## Context

PR #339 began in Week 3 by splitting labels into SVG `<tspan>` elements. That solved “draw every line,” but it did not yet reserve enough space for those lines.

## What I Did

- Added a browser-geometry test to [PR #339](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/339) on July 18.
- Compared strip and panel positions instead of only checking that multiple `<tspan>` elements existed.
- Updated the strip offset and text measurement to include every rendered line.
- Checked the change through both `facet_grid()` and `facet_wrap()` paths.

## Learnings

I had solved “draw more than one line,” but not “leave room for more than one line.” The failing geometry test made that distinction visible.

## Challenges / Notes

Browser font measurements vary slightly, so the test compares the strip and panel boundaries instead of depending on one exact pixel value.

## Next Week Targets

Work through the review comments on custom-height facets, legend control, and positive panel margins.
